text: An intruder! In MY pages!
Who snuck into the Bug Book? I'll count the clues! Can I help? Can I?
Every detective needs a lens! Big secrets of tiny bugs!
The Insects page... and a sticker that doesn't belong!
One, two, three, four... five, six, seven, eight!
Eight legs?! Insects have SIX! This page is for insects only. But WHY?
Rules are rules!
Every intruder leaves clues. Three clues! I counted! Let's zoom in!
A shiny string! It's silk! Silk? Only spiders make silk, right?
Only spiders? Nope!
Look! My baby pictures!
Before Flutter was a butterfly... Flutter was a caterpillar!
And caterpillars make silk too!
Oh! To make a cocoon? Nope! A tiny silk pad... to hang on while it changes!
Flutter made silk once... So Flutter is a suspect!
Clue number one!
Look! Tiny footprints in the eraser dust! Count them with me!
One, two, three, four... five, six, seven, eight! Eight feet in every step!
Flutter has six feet...
so it was NOT Flutter! Then who has eight legs?
Did you see that?
Clue number two!
A wing! It's a butterfly wing!
Wait... let me take a closer look.
It's paper! With sticky tape! A paper wing? But WHY?
Somebody wanted to LOOK like a bug! A disguise! In MY book!
Clue number three!
Silk... eight feet... a paper wing. Time for a lineup!
Suspects! Step in line!
Count the legs with Dot! Waggle... one, two, three, four, five, six!
Six legs! A bug! Flutter... six legs! Chirp... six legs!
Bug! Bug! And you... one, two, three, four, five, six!
Six legs! See? I am a bug! Really? Six? Let's zoom in!
Seven... eight! EIGHT legs! Oopsie!
Now count the body parts! Waggle: one, two, three! Spindle: one, two!
Bugs have three body parts. Spiders have two! And one more secret...
Bugs have two antennae.
Spiders have none! Oh! Those were paper. BZZT! Not a bug!
Is it my turn yet? But did she sneak in? We didn't SEE her!
Then let's catch the intruder... in the act!
My trap! A shiny empty spot! Every intruder wants a spot!
Snore... snore... I am totally asleep... Shh... one, two, three...
A bug! With wings and stripes! One, two... six legs! Hold on... are you sure?
Gotcha! Eight legs! BZZT! Not a bug!
You caught me! I only wanted one page.
But WHY can't she join? Rules are rules. This book is for insects.
Okay! Maybe one day?
...I'll think about it.
Case closed! Little detectives, remember... How many legs does a bug have?
Six legs! And a spider?
Eight legs! Count carefully... before you decide!
Wait! Did you spot Rollo?
Now let me count YOU! One, two... Two legs! Not a bug either!
Is it my turn yet? So... is a spider a bug?
Nope!
